scope: Read-only signed-in QA. Browser-local delay of one real startup JS response, released unchanged. No API response injection, resource creation, paid action, or product fix.

replay.instructions: Obtain your own signed-in QA browser via scripts/qa-login.sh; never embed cookies. Evaluate the factory, call it with each receipt URL, exact textbox label, width and marker, then execute the returned async(page) function. Name cases used V2; Blueprint path and Service port used V3. Port replay replaces marker+"-ready" with marker so the control remains numeric. Retained modified mobile/path snippets include the exact screenshots and selection differences. Update only the hashed startup URL if deployment changed. A valid deliberate-hold capture requires delayApplied:true, scripts status 200, an enabled pre-handler input and a trusted event with reactProps:false. Finally always unroute and release pending response promises.

dependencyResearch.mechanism: initInput preserves the DOM value while hydrating. Later updateInput writes the controlled prop when it differs from the DOM. Pre-handler native input cannot update component state. Receipts show the same node preserving then reverting its value.
dependencyResearch.limitation: This is source research at the lockfile-pinned version, not an independently extracted React version from the deployed entry asset.
